name: wporg-developer
description: The codebase and development environment for Developer.WordPress.org.
author: WordPress.org

scripts.playground:import-docs: jq --arg postType "${IMPORT_POST_TYPE:?Usage: IMPORT_POST_TYPE=playground yarn playground:import-docs}" '.steps += [{"step":"defineWpConfigConsts","consts":{"IMPORT_POST_TYPE":$postType}},{"step":"runPHP","code":"<?php class WP_CLI { public static function log( $message ) { error_log( $message ); } public static function warning( $message ) { error_log( \"Warning: $message\" ); } public static function success( $message ) { error_log( \"Success: $message\" ); } public static function error( $message ) { throw new RuntimeException( $message ); } } require_once \"/wordpress/wp-load.php\"; do_action( \"devhub_\" . IMPORT_POST_TYPE . \"_import_manifest\" ); do_action( \"devhub_\" . IMPORT_POST_TYPE . \"_import_all_markdown\" );"}]' "${PLAYGROUND_BLUEPRINT:-./source/wp-content/blueprint.json}" > ./source/wp-content/.playground-import-docs.blueprint.json && PLAYGROUND_BLUEPRINT=./source/wp-content/.playground-import-docs.blueprint.json yarn playground
scripts.setup:tools: yarn && composer install && TEXTDOMAIN=wporg composer exec update-configs && composer --working-dir=./source/wp-content/plugins/phpdoc-parser install
scripts.parse: wp-env run cli wp devhub parse --user_id=1
scripts.sweep:prepare: wp-env run cli bash env/sweep/scripts/setup.sh && wp-env run cli bash env/sweep/scripts/parse.sh && wp-env run cli wp eval-file env/sweep/scripts/manifest.php
scripts.update:tools: composer update && TEXTDOMAIN=wporg composer exec update-configs && composer --working-dir=./source/wp-content/plugins/phpdoc-parser update
